tests: decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active ACP repair bounds the complete candidate source tree including an unselected sibling
command: ./gradlew --offline test --console=plain -Pkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process -x verifyFrontendToolchain -x frontendInstall -x frontendBuild -x generateFrontendAssetManifest -x verifyFrontendAssets --tests 'decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active ACP repair bounds the complete candidate source tree including an unselected sibling'

scope.provider: scripted ACP process through the active repair loop
scope.coverage: Paired fresh projects stage only src/modules/reconstructed.c while retaining src/modules/secondary.c as an unchanged source outside that staging context. A 128-byte replacement reaches the injected validator at an aggregate maximumSourceBytes ceiling measured from the complete candidate source tree, including the sibling. A 129-byte replacement is acknowledged and read back through ACP, then refused while constructing the complete immutable validator request. The refusal is typed as candidate-source resource exhaustion, produces RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED with a NOT_RUN validation assessment and resource-exhausted reason, and does not invoke the validator. Both arms verify exact candidate-source digests, receipt changes, receipt/assessment binding, accepted source/head preservation, rejected node, no pending attempt, and sandbox/process cleanup.
qualificationLimits: uses an injected validator rather than production validation under #236
